title: visualization settings dialog: the store windows say where they store and are less wide
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-19: the window of 'store settings' has a button 'store'; it becomes 'store in config.json' with a hint, because the positions are stored in the same local file; the descriptions of the 'store settings' and 'store positions' windows are one long line and get line breaks.
releaseNotes: The store settings and store positions windows of the visualization settings dialog have a button 'store in config.json' with a tooltip naming the file, and their descriptions are wrapped (revision2026c step RG6.19.6)
